[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Krempil''' of the [[Malarian Alliance]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[officer]]. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], a [[Unidentified patrol cruiser|patrol cruiser]] was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by Krempil and assigned two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] observers, [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and [[Ring-Sol Ambase]], to hunt [[Hethra Mcgrrrr/Legends|Hethra Mcgrrrr's]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Black Hole Gang/Legends|gang]].

They had been tracking the ''[[Random Mallet]]'' for three days when they cornered it in a nebula, although the pirate ship escaped. Dooku considered the officer to be a coward and a fool.

==Behind the scenes==
Krempil appears in [[Ryder Windham]]'s yoing readers novel ''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''.
